platform.name: Kalam Learning
platform.tagline: Practical skills for the people who run customer experience.
platform.intro: Practical courses built from Kalam CX's own training: real tools and real call-center data, taught by the people who use them every day.
platform.mode: Public prototype. All courses are free. No accounts: progress stays in this browser only.

team.title: Learn together. Grow together.
team.text: Every course here is made for everyone at Kalam, from the floor to the back office. Pick a skill, learn it at your own pace, and use it at work tomorrow.
team.alt: The Kalam CX family, around twenty colleagues, standing together and smiling.

topics.name: Customer Experience
topics.blurb: Handling customers, quality and the skills of the floor.

topics.name: Leadership
topics.blurb: Leading teams, coaching and running the floor.

instructors.name: Mohamed Fawzy
instructors.title: Workforce Management, Kalam CX
instructors.bio: Mohamed Fawzy works in Workforce Management at Kalam CX and uses Excel every day for forecasting, scheduling and reporting. He teaches the way he works: straight on real exports, explaining each formula so you can rebuild it yourself.

instructors.name: Excel creators on YouTube
instructors.title: Curated, not affiliated
instructors.bio: Free lessons by well-known Excel teachers, including Leila Gharani, Kevin Stratvert, MyOnlineTrainingHub, Excel Campus, GoSkills and GCFLearnFree. Videos play from YouTube and belong to their creators. Kalam CX isn't affiliated with these channels.
